title: Brownian motion
description: Free Brownian motion $dX_t = \sigma\,dW_t$: the potential is $\Psi = 0$, and all 500 particles start at the origin. Press play (space) and watch the cloud spread. The Observable window plots $\mathbb{E}|X_t|^2$ over time; use the early part, before particles leave the dashed box.

questions.text: How does $\mathbb{E}|X_t|^2$ grow with $t$: like $t$, $\sqrt{t}$ or $t^2$?
Read off the slope of $\mathbb{E}|X_t|^2$ against $t$ (σ = 1).
Set σ = 0.5 and restart. By what factor does the slope change?
So how does the typical distance from the origin grow with $t$? Relate it to the quadratic variation $\langle W \rangle_t = t$.
